name: Stack
description: Stacks children in a row or column with one consistent gap.

gap.description: Spacing between items: "none"|"xs"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"|"xl", a number (1-8) for space scale, or responsive object

separator.description: Render a separator between children. true = default 1px line, or pass a ReactNode for custom separators.

when: Spacing a short row or column of elements
Layouts that flip direction at a breakpoint
whenNot: Grouping buttons into one control (use ButtonGroup)
guidelines: Set gap once on the parent instead of margins on children
Numeric gaps (1-8) map to the same spacing scale as the tokens
direction, gap, and align all accept per-breakpoint objects
Use as="nav" or as="ul" so the markup stays semantic
separator draws dividers without extra elements
accessibility: Use semantic elements (nav, section, etc.) via "as" prop
Maintains source order for screen readers
No accessibility concerns with visual arrangement

examples.name: Vertical Stack
examples.description: Children flow top to bottom — the default.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack gap="sm">
  <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">One</Box>
  <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">Two</Box>
  <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">Three</Box>
</Stack>

examples.name: Horizontal Stack
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm">
  <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">One</Box>
  <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">Two</Box>
  <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">Three</Box>
</Stack>

examples.name: Gap Sizes
examples.description: One spacing token sets every gap in the stack.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack gap="lg">
  <Stack direction="row" gap="xs">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">xs</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">xs</Box>
  </Stack>
  <Stack direction="row" gap="sm">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">sm</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">sm</Box>
  </Stack>
  <Stack direction="row" gap="md">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">md</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">md</Box>
  </Stack>
  <Stack direction="row" gap="lg">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">lg</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="md" paddingY="sm">lg</Box>
  </Stack>
</Stack>

examples.name: Alignment
examples.description: justify positions children along the main axis.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack gap="md">
  <Box width="240px" border rounded="sm" padding="sm">
    <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" justify="between">
      <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="sm" paddingY="xs">Start</Box>
      <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="sm" paddingY="xs">End</Box>
    </Stack>
  </Box>
  <Box width="240px" border rounded="sm" padding="sm">
    <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" justify="center">
      <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" paddingX="sm" paddingY="xs">Centered</Box>
    </Stack>
  </Box>
</Stack>

examples.name: Responsive
examples.description: Swap direction and gap per breakpoint with an object value.
examples.code:
<Stack
  direction={{ base: 'column', md: 'row' }}
  gap={{ base: 'sm', md: 'lg' }}
>
  <Button variant="soft">First</Button>
  <Button variant="soft">Second</Button>
  <Button variant="soft">Third</Button>
</Stack>

examples.name: With Separator
examples.description: Draws a divider between each child.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<Stack gap="md" separator>
  <Text>Section one</Text>
  <Text>Section two</Text>
  <Text>Section three</Text>
</Stack>

examples.name: Semantic Element
examples.description: The as prop renders a real nav, section, or list element.
examples.code:
<Stack as="nav" direction="row" gap="md">
  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Home</Button>
  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">About</Button>
  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Contact</Button>
</Stack>

propsSummary: gap: none|xs|sm|md|lg|xl|number|{responsive} - spacing (number maps to space scale)
Pass-through DOM props supported on the root (id, role, aria-*, data-*, handlers)
